title: finding(fields): a lookup value picked in the dropdown before the referenced object's schema loads keeps its no-schema label, so its chip ignores `nameField` for good
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a). It is the pick-path sibling of objectui#10487. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10487 (PR objectui#10557). ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## Site (read by the seat on the PR head; `origin/main` `93a689d7c` has the same pick path)

`packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`: `handleSelect` caches the BUILT option it is handed, and the row behind it is not kept (`recordToOption` spreads the record under `label` / `value` / `description`). So a pick made before `refObjectSchema` resolves is labelled on the no-schema path and never relabelled. The browse-all dialog path (`handlePickerSelectRecords`) builds options the same way; that half is **not measured**.

## Reproduction (the dev's throwaway probe on PR objectui#10557's head `011676680`, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

Mount empty, hold the schema, open the dropdown, pick `c1`, then release the schema. The card's fixture: `nameField: 'contract_no'`, rows `{ id: 'c1', name: 'Acme', contract_no: 'HT-001' }`, …

| moment | reading |
|:--|:--|
| options before the schema | `['Acme', 'Initech']` |
| chip after the pick | `['Acme']` |
| chip after the schema arrives | `['Acme']` |
| options after the schema | `['HT-001', 'HT-002']` |

So the chip and the dropdown disagree for good on the pick path. PR objectui#10557 fixed exactly this on the hydration path.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The shape of the fix is objectui#10557's: keep the picked ROW and derive the option on render through the same `recordToOption` inputs. The dev did not fix it in place because it needs a design step: which row a pick keeps, and how quick-create and static options fit.
- No `Blocked-by:`. It lands after PR objectui#10557 in the same file.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). `handleSelect`, `pickerResolvedRecords` and `handlePickerSelectRecords` ⇒ only objectui#10487 / PR objectui#10557 (and PR objectui#10479, closed). The label near schema / `nameField` ⇒ those plus objectui#10343 (closed, the option-label ranking). Must-hit control `LookupField` ⇒ 22 hits; objectui#10486 is the record picker's display column, a different site.

Dedupe words: `LookupField handleSelect pick before schema label` · `lookup picked chip label frozen before nameField` · `handlePickerSelectRecords label refObjectSchema`
